address: Route du Pas de l'Ours 41, Crans-Montana, 3963, Switzerland
bio: It's easy to feel at home in this bistro with its rustic, mountain-inspired atmosphere, complete with terrace commanding a magnificent view of the valley and the surrounding mountains. Here they serve ambitious French-Mediterranean cuisine that caters to all food lovers, courtesy of chef Franck Reynaud, who also cooks at the Michelin-starred restaurant, L'Ours. You'll want to come back for more of this delicious fare that will have your taste buds tingling!...
